# Store triggers

## Store item redeemed

Runs when a viewer buys something from your points store, and it is approved. Good for doing what the item promises, like playing a sound.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The store item's name, exactly as in your store. Empty means any item. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%item%` | The name of the item |
| `%user%` | The viewer who bought it |
| `%cost%` | How many points it cost |
| `%input%` | Extra text the viewer typed with the purchase |
| `%platform%` | The site the viewer is on, like twitch |
| `%redemptionId%` | The purchase's internal id |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.storeRedeemed`</small>

## Store redemption rejected

Runs when a store purchase is turned down and the points are given back. Good for telling the viewer why.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The store item's name, exactly as in your store. Empty means any item. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%item%` | The name of the item |
| `%user%` | The viewer who tried to buy it |
| `%cost%` | How many points are given back |
| `%redemptionId%` | The purchase's internal id |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.storeRejected`</small>

## Store redemption waiting for approval

Runs when a store purchase is waiting for you to approve it. Good for a popup or sound telling you to check it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The store item's name, exactly as in your store. Empty means any item. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%item%` | The name of the item |
| `%user%` | The viewer who bought it |
| `%cost%` | How many points it cost |
| `%input%` | Extra text the viewer typed with the purchase |
| `%redemptionId%` | The purchase's internal id (use it with "Approve or reject store redemption") |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.storePending`</small>
